note: While mailsync downloads a message body (UID FETCH ... BODY.PEEK[]), another client expunges UID 150. The QRESYNC server reports '* VANISHED 150' on that same connection. mailsync harvests VANISHED only after IDLE, so this one is dropped - and because the server considers this connection informed, the next CHANGEDSINCE fetch reports nothing while LS_HIGHESTMODSEQ advances past the expunge.
